svg.title: The Hot Rocks Sauna and Lough Neagh
svg.desc: Regional map locating The Hot Rocks Sauna at Gawley’s Gate on the south-east shore of Lough Neagh, west of Belfast and Lisburn and north of Lurgan. Selected motorways and major roads provide regional context. The B156 meets the B12 near Aghagallon and Glenavy. Lower Ballinderry Road links the B12 to the A26 Moira Road. Small building symbols mark the four settlements. The main intercity corridors include the M1 and M2. An aircraft icon marks Belfast International Airport, south of Antrim. Map data from OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL) and Natural Earth.
